name: On-Board Software Memory Usage
description: RAM usage of the on-board software. Checks whether sufficient memory headroom remains for in-orbit updates.

elements.name: On-Board SW RAM Usage
elements.description: RAM consumed by the flight software stack. Uncertain due to compiler optimisation variability and dynamic allocation.

uncertainty.source: Cross-compilation and heap analysis across build variants

elements.name: Available RAM Budget
elements.description: Maximum RAM allocated to flight software in memory map

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ_stack(RAM) = stack_usage, σ_heap(RAM) = heap_usage, σ_os(RAM) = os_overhead; sum must satisfy RAM_stack+RAM_heap+RAM_os <= RAM_budget
consistency_relations.upr_description: Total flight software RAM usage decomposes into three structurally independent contributions: stack usage, dynamic heap allocation, and OS/middleware overhead. The structural mapping propagates each component's uncertainty set separately, and the consistency condition requires that the sum of all three components stays within the 55 MB memory budget.
